name: iSup_basicOpen_eq_top'
statement: Type*} (f : ι → A) (hfn : ∀ i, ∃ n, f i ∈ 𝒜 n) (hf : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) (Set.range f) = ⊤) : ⨆ i, Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 (f i) = ⊤

name: basicOpenIsoSpec
statement: (basicOpen 𝒜 f).toScheme ≅ Spec (.of <| Away 𝒜 f)

name: basicOpenIsoAway
statement: CommRingCat.of (Away 𝒜 f) ≅ Γ(Proj 𝒜, basicOpen 𝒜 f)

name: homOfLE_toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections_ι
statement: f t = x} {h0d : 0 < d} {hd : t ∈ 𝒜 d} {H' : f t' = x'} {h0d' : 0 < d'} {hd' : t' ∈ 𝒜 d'} {s : A} (hts : t * s = t') {n : ℕ} (hn : d + n = d') (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 n) : X.homOfLE (by aesop) ≫ toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections 𝒜 f H h0d hd ≫ (basicOpen 𝒜 t).ι = toBasicOpenOfGlobalSections 𝒜 f H' h0d' hd' ≫ (basicOpen 𝒜 t').ι
